title: PARALLAX / DREAMSTATE V4 dependence-aware robustness on current live main
summary: PARALLAX / DREAMSTATE V4 adds episode-aware effective sample size, Newey-West/HAC dependence-adjusted inference, BH-FDR over the same dependence-adjusted p-values, and cross-revision contradiction/transportability diagnostics while preserving V3 temporal and parameter-basin robustness. During current-main audit, a real defect was found where BH family ranking still used naive p-values despite the HAC screen; that path is now corrected and regression-locked. DREAMSTATE carries the resulting evidence into policy contracts, Brain mirrors, search accounting, refresh, and live source revalidation. All authority remains research/shadow only.
evidence: context.episode_id collapses repeated decisions into one effective episode mean
raw paired N and effective N remain separately auditable
Newey-West/HAC uncertainty replaces naive screening uncertainty when evaluable
BH-FDR ranking and q-values use screen_p_one_sided when HAC is active

regression commit 9634f0f2ffcc4a87a2d4dad049b3956fea12efa9 locks HAC-adjusted BH behavior
